Platform Zero

Game Design Project | 2026-2027

About the Game

Platform Zero is a story-based mystery game with a countdown theme. You wake up in an empty underground train station, and the power will shut down in ten minutes. Every choice takes time. You have to explore the station, find clues and decide who to trust before time runs out.

We want to make a short game with different choices and multiple endings. The visual style is inspired by low-poly PS1-era games.
